source.title: PROC-SOURCING-001: authorized acquisition receipts to attributable sourcing candidates
source.body:
## Purpose

Define the Symthaea-side adapter between evidence-first external acquisition and Mycelix's capability-first sourcing evaluator ([Mycelix PR #5072](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/pull/5072)). Reuse existing OSINT/tool-selection, provenance, component identity and Mycelix execution receipts; do not create another browser/network authority path.

## Existing owners to compose

- Symthaea RES-OSINT-001 / #5417: bounded investigation state machine and search-plan semantics.
- Symthaea RES-OSINT-TOOL-001 / #5440: reasoning-only tool/source adapter selection.
- Symthaea RES-SEC-001D / #5569: retire legacy direct WebResearcher egress from the cognitive authority path.
- Symthaea ROB-CATALOG-001 / #4877: physical component, datasheet, BOM and substitution identity.
- Symthaea provenance/revocation contract, PR #7553: source/publisher identity, revision/digest anchors, retrieval time, integrity result, lifecycle, rights, and claim-validity semantics.
- Mycelix #1110 and #5005: supply-chain traceability bridge and versioned logistics standards registry.
- Mycelix #5037 / #5072: need-to-fulfilment and capability-first sourcing comparison.
- Sol Atlas PR #101: geographic/supply-network and disruption context, with explicit evidence maturity.

## Core boundary

```text
candidate search plan
  != permission to disclose query

authorized external execution receipt
  != evidence truth

supplier page / parsed offer
  != verified stock

engineering component
  != merchant listing
  != purchased article

sourcing frontier
  != winner
  != purchase authorization
  != order dispatch
```

Symthaea should reason about source and method selection, consume exact authorized-acquisition receipts, and emit attributable candidate projections. It must not instantiate a raw network client from a cognition path, self-mint disclosure permits, interpret no result as proof of absence, or route a candidate directly to checkout.

## Candidate projection contract

A first reference adapter should preserve, without promoting caller claims into verified facts:

- source/receipt identity, exact retrieval or observation time, source locator, content digest and integrity-verifier reference;
- acquisition and extraction profile identities and versions;
- supplier/listing identity separately from physical component identity;
- manufacturer part number/revision, exact variant and capability-profile reference when available;
- quote currency/unit, per-unit price and quantity basis, minimum-order/pack-size semantics, shipping/tax/fees, quote validity;
- inventory quantity, inventory-specific observation time, expiration/currentness and evidence origin/status;
- declared lead time, geography and evidence provenance;
- explicit unknown/contested/unavailable fields rather than fabricated defaults;
- reviewed substitution mapping reference and version, when a listed item differs from the requested canonical capability.

ValueFlows, GS1 EPCIS/CBV and UBL/OCDS are mapping targets where applicable—not permission to conflate intent, commitment, provider claim, observed event, supplier listing, shipment and physical truth.

## Implementation sequence

1. Inventory the exact existing source-receipt/provenance/component contracts before adding types.
2. Define a read-only projection from qualified receipt + field-level extraction evidence into the Mycelix sourcing offer input.
3. Keep extraction, evidence integrity, issuer trust, quote/stock currentness, capability equivalence and procurement authority as separate gates.
4. Add offline fixtures for price/stock timestamp divergence, source-content mutation, redirect/new-origin mismatch, hostile page instructions, unit/currency mismatch, pack-size/MOQ, substitution drift, duplicate listings, stale credentials, unknown fields and exact replay.
5. Add a separate oracle that validates projection completeness and rejected/indeterminate cases without importing the production adapter implementation.
6. Only later, wire an RFQ/purchase-order draft flow through Mycelix. Transactional execution must remain in its separately authorized gateway.

## Proposed acceptance targets (not measured)

- 100% of emitted offer fields map to an explicit field-level evidence reference or an explicit unknown state.
- Zero unverified/stale/conflicting quote or stock observations promoted to eligible.
- Zero implicit unit/currency/pack-size conversions.
- Zero substitutions admitted without a matching versioned capability-equivalence reference.
- Zero cross-origin or redirected external destinations treated as authorized by the original request.
- 100% duplicate/replay fixtures deterministic; source mutation invalidates the relevant digest binding.
- No cognitive-path network/credential authority; only the exact authorized execution receipt may advance acquisition state.
- Measure projection latency separately from network acquisition and sourcing evaluation; freeze host, corpus and toolchain before reporting.

## Scope ceiling

This is not a browser rewrite, a general supplier registry, a product crawler, a truth oracle, an automatic public-sector integrity finding, or purchase execution. Do not duplicate Mycelix's canonical EPI, supplier, component or logistics semantics. The first deliverable is a read-only, effects-disabled projection plus adversarial fixtures.


## Procurement portfolio/recourse integration (2026-10-17)

Compose with the new Mycelix portfolio and adaptive-recourse slices rather than building an independent supplier-ranking or execution path:

- [Mycelix #5088 — portfolio sourcing](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/issues/5088), [PR #5099 — bounded exact portfolio allocator](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/pull/5099), and [PR #5108 — scenario-specific adaptive recourse](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/pull/5108).
- [Mycelix #5109 — ex-ante selection of flexible/backup commitments](https://github.com/Luminous-Dynamics/mycelix/issues/5109) is a separate follow-on task; #5108 evaluates a fixed baseline and already-committed option set.
- Candidate projections should preserve normal/base allocation versus flexible/backup option semantics, capacity-pool identity and snapshot, reservation/activation fees, activation lead plus transit time, quote/qualification/capacity freshness, and declared parent/site/sub-tier/route failure domains.
- Do not let a Symthaea forecast become a verified capacity observation. Do not count source-name diversity as resilience when the sourced dependency graph overlaps.
- Emit attributable, advisory candidate/forecast records with source, model, timestamp, uncertainty and input-manifest identities. Mycelix remains the authority/evidence record owner; actual contract changes and purchases require a separate authorized workflow.
- For first evaluation, use Mycelix's frozen synthetic scenarios and compare forecasts against later observed outcomes. Keep synthetic scenario results separate from live-domain source evidence.
